purpose: SpringCat UI exploration; mock data, not implemented product screens
initial:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished desktop product UX concept board for SpringCat, an existing local desktop companion for multi-tool AI work. This is a speculative redesign, not an Apple product. Reference image is ONLY the existing SpringCat cat logo (smiling cropped black cat head); preserve its recognizable silhouette in a very small tasteful product mark. Chinese-first UI, perfectly legible Chinese typography with SF Pro / PingFang feel. Presentation: landscape 1536x1024, meticulous professional industrial design review, not a marketing landing page, no laptop/device rendering, no giant hero text, no sci-fi, no neon, no chrome/glowing metallic orb. Board has a small design name top-left, a main carefully composed large UI mockup in the right two-thirds with enough realistic desktop context, and a tidy left column showing compact resting and peek states at readable sizes with small labels. Footer small exact text “SpringCat · 交互概念 / 示例任务”. Use precise near-opaque surfaces and restrained translucent edges with convincing soft natural shadows, very readable real task rows, generous negative space, optical alignment. Current functionality is task monitoring, history and usage. Future action launchers are concepts and labelled “概念”. Put no fake percent progress, no fabricated metrics dashboard.
Concept A: “A / 静谧状态岛”. Premium graphite / ink-black system companion, tiny muted mint activity dot. Warm very pale grey desktop background. Resting object 48px dark squircle/circle with recognizable white cat mark. Peek object 264x52 horizontal dark capsule, SAME cat mark fixed at the left, text “2 个进行中” and subtle count “1 待查看”. Expanded unified single dark rounded panel 344px wide at UI scale, not an orb beside a separate card. Header same fixed mark, “SpringCat”, small close/minimize control. Summary “需要你看一下”. First prioritized task with subtle amber dot, “Codex”, title “重构设置页”, secondary “等待你的确认”, primary subdued light button “返回对话”. Divider then two compact rows “Cursor  /  登录测试通过” with “已完成”; “Gemini  /  整理设计文档” with “进行中”. Bottom unobtrusive navigation text “动态   快捷动作   回顾”, 动态 selected; tiny 概念 above quick action label if needed. One large expanded panel hero on right; left shows circle and capsule with labels “安静待命” and “一眼知晓”. Fixed mark matches all states, unified same surface, calm and highly legible. No extra floating decorative orb.
